svg.text: General arrangement · JS1-102 · revision B · 11 November 2026
Johansson Shipyard, newbuilding No. 1, rebuilt at 68 m for Johansson Line. A proposal for the owner's approval: nothing of it is calculated or built yet.
Bow to the right, port up. Metres.
Watertight bulkheads at the frames named; frame spacing 0.6 m, frame 0 at the transom. Scale: the ticks are ten frames (6 m) apart.

FOR THE OWNER TO SETTLE BEFORE SHE IS BUILT
1. The chief engineer's suite: 23 m² with the rooms and fittings of the owner's suite package rearranged to fit (drawn); or the package's own 36 m² (7.2 m by 5.0 m), which takes the second
2. The bow: a visor and an inner ramp, driven through (drawn); or her old way, a blunt bow that the ramp itself closes.
3. The saloon to the ship's side with windows (drawn), or narrower with a promenade outside it on each side.
4. Where the owner's two rooms stand: in one house on the top deck with the CO₂ room and the batteries (drawn).
5. The emergency generator's size: the owner's drawing names 500 kW; her own emergency loads (steering, fire and drencher pumps, lighting, navigation) come to something near 200 kW. The room
is drawn at the drawing's size either way.
6. Her service speed and engines (14 knots, two of 1,470 kW): they set the engine room's length.

Made from ferry/blender/ga.py by ferry/yard/drawings/ga_drawing.py. Proportions as the yard recalls small coastal car and passenger ferries of this length; no ship was copied and no rule text was read for this revision.
